# summary function
```{r}
df_summary <- function(data) {
  res <- list()
  
  # 使用 pblapply 取代 for 迴圈，自動顯示進度條
  temp_res <- pblapply(colnames(data), function(col) {
    # 計算每個 unique 值出現次數
    tbl <- data.frame(table(data[[col]], useNA = "ifany"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(tbl) <- c("values", "times")
    
    list(
      unique = tbl,
      NAs = sum(is.na(data[[col]])),
      type = class(data[[col]])[1]
    )
  })
  
  # 將結果組回 list，欄位名稱對應原欄位
  names(temp_res) <- colnames(data)
  res <- temp_res
  
  return(res)
}
```

# summary
```{r}

```

```{r}
data_path = "../區域分析code/"
coor_intercity <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "公路客運站點里程.csv"), fileEncoding = "BIG5", colClasses = "character")

# 欄位名稱列表，需要轉成數值
num_cols <- c("Direction", "StopID", "StopBoarding", "StopSequence",
              "PositionLon", "PositionLat", "StationID", "Dist_Cum", "Dist_Intv")

# 批量轉換函數
convert_to_numeric <- function(df, cols) {
  for (col in cols) {
    if (col %in% names(df)) {
      df[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[col]]))
    }
  }
  return(df)
}

# 套用到三個 CSV
coor_intercity <- convert_to_numeric(coor_intercity, num_cols)
coor_HUA       <- convert_to_numeric(coor_HUA, num_cols)
coor_TTT       <- convert_to_numeric(coor_TTT, num_cols)
```

## reduce coor
```{r}
coor <- coor_original %>% 
  select(
    RouteName, 
    SubRouteName, 
    StopName, PositionLon, 
    PositionLat, 
    LocationCityCode
    ) %>%
  filter(
    LocationCityCode %in% c("TTT", "HUA")
    )

coor
```

```{r}
# pblapply 逐景點比對
results_list <- pblapply(1:nrow(spots), function(i) {
  spot <- spots[i, ]
  
  # 計算每個站點到這個景點的距離
  coor$dist_m <- distHaversine(
    matrix(c(coor$PositionLon, coor$PositionLat), ncol = 2),
    c(spot$lon, spot$lat)
  )
  
  # 篩選距離小於 d_meter 的站點
  matched <- coor %>%
    filter(dist_m <= d_meter) %>%
    select(RouteName, StopName)
  
  if(nrow(matched) > 0){
    tibble(
      路線 = matched$RouteName,
      景點 = spot$景點,
      站名 = matched$StopName
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }
})

# 合併所有結果
df_route_spot_long <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(路線, 站名) %>%
  slice(1) %>%        # 只保留配對到的第一筆景點
  ungroup()
```

# 觀光景點人數統計長條圖
```{r}
tourist_attraction_visitor_statistics_histgram <- function(year.from, year.to) {
  color <- gray.colors(length(year.from:year.to) + 1)
  
  data <- df %>%
    inner_join(df_route_spot_long, by = c("路線" = "路線", "下車站牌名稱" = "站名")) %>%
    filter(年份 >= year.from - 1911 & 年份 <= year.to - 1911) %>% 
    group_by(年份, 景點) %>%
    summarise(人數 = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    complete(年份, 景點 = factor(unique(spots$景點), levels = unique(spots$景點)), fill = list(人數 = 0)) %>%
    arrange(年份, 景點)
  
  df_data <- data %>%
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = 景點,
        values_from = 人數,
        values_fill = 0  # 沒有的補0
    ) %>%
    data.frame()
  
  # 寫入 .xlsx
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "觀光景點人數統計")
  writeData(wb, sheet = "觀光景點人數統計", x = df_data)
  xlsx_path = paste0("datasets/", year.from - 1911, "-", year.to - 1911)
  if (!dir.exists(xlsx_path)) {
    dir.create(xlsx_path, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  saveWorkbook(wb, file = paste0(xlsx_path, "/臺東縣重要交通觀光景點下車人數統計.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
  
  data$景點 <- factor(data$景點, levels = unique(spots$景點))
  #data = data %>% filter(景點 != "花蓮轉運站/車站")
  #data = data %>% mutate(人數 = sqrt(人數))
  
  p = ggplot(data, aes(x = 景點, y = 人數, fill = factor(年份))) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.8) +          # 分組長條圖 # 調小長條寬度 → gap 變大
    scale_fill_manual(values = color) +     # 使用自訂灰階色
    scale_y_continuous(
      trans = "sqrt",               # 對柱子高度做 sqrt 變換
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),   # 刻度
      labels = scales::comma       # 顯示原始數字
    ) +
    labs(x = "", 
         y = "人數", 
         fill = "年度", 
         title = paste0(year.from - 1911, '年至', year.to - 1911, '年臺東縣重要交通觀光景點下車人數統計')
         ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + 
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Kai", size = 16),          # 基本文字大小
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),                    # x, y 軸標題
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),                     # x, y 軸文字
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20),                    # 圖標題
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16),                  # 圖例標題
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),                   # 圖例文字
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray80"),     # 僅保留橫線
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),  # 面板背景白色
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)    # 圖片背景白色
    )
  return(p)
}

generate_tourist_attraction_visitor_statistics_histgram <- function(year.from, year.to) {
  # 儲存圖片
  path = paste0("images/barplot/", year.from - 1911, "-", year.to - 1911)
  check_path(path)
  img_filename = paste0(year.from - 1911, '年至', year.to - 1911, '年臺東縣重要交通觀光景點下車人數統計')
  p = tourist_attraction_visitor_statistics_histgram(year.from, year.to)
  ggsave(filename = paste0(path, "/", img_filename, ".png"), plot = p, width = 15, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
}

# 繪圖
generate_tourist_attraction_visitor_statistics_histgram(2023, 2025)
```

# 觀光景點上下車人數及百分比前三名及後三名路線
```{r}
top3_and_bottom3_analysis <- function(year.from, year.to){
  
  data <- df %>%
    inner_join(df_route_spot_long, by = c("路線" = "路線", "下車站牌名稱" = "站名")) %>%
    mutate(年份 = year(日期) - 1911) %>% 
    filter(年份 >= year.from - 1911 & 年份 <= year.to - 1911) %>% 
    group_by(路線, 景點) %>%
    summarise(人數 = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  df_total <- data %>% 
    group_by(景點) %>% 
    summarise(總數 = sum(人數, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    
  df_top <- data %>%
    group_by(景點) %>%
    arrange(desc(人數), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = 3) %>%
    left_join(df_total, by = "景點") %>%
    mutate(百分比 = ifelse(is.na(人數), NA, ((人數 / 總數 * 100) %>% round(., 2) %>% paste0(., "%"))),
           rank = row_number()
           ) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    complete(nesting(景點), rank = 1:3, fill = list(路線 = NA, 人數 = NA, 百分比 = NA)) %>%
    mutate(類別 = paste0("Top", rank)) %>%
    select(-rank, -總數)
  
  df_bottom <- data %>%
    group_by(景點) %>%
    arrange(人數, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = 3) %>%
    left_join(df_total, by = "景點") %>%
    mutate(百分比 = ifelse(is.na(人數), NA, ((人數 / 總數 * 100) %>% round(., 2) %>% paste0(., "%"))),
           rank = row_number()
           ) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    complete(nesting(景點), rank = 1:3, fill = list(路線 = NA, 人數 = NA, 百分比 = NA)) %>%
    mutate(類別 = paste0("Bottom", rank)) %>%
    select(-rank, -總數)
  
  df_data <- bind_cols(df_top, df_bottom)
  
  print(df_data)
    
  # 寫入 .xlsx
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "臺東縣觀光景點上下車人數及百分比前三名及後三名路線")
  writeData(wb, sheet = "臺東縣觀光景點上下車人數及百分比前三名及後三名路線", x = df_data)
  xlsx_path = paste0("datasets/", year.from - 1911, "-", year.to - 1911)
  if (!dir.exists(xlsx_path)) {
    dir.create(xlsx_path, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  saveWorkbook(wb, file = paste0(xlsx_path, "/臺東縣觀光景點上下車人數及百分比前三名及後三名路線.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
}

top3_and_bottom3_analysis(2023, 2025)
```

# 平假日分析
```{r}
weekday_analysis <- function(year.from, year.to){
  
  data <- df %>%
    filter(
      日期 >= as.Date(paste0(year.from, "-01-01")),
      日期 <= as.Date(paste0(year.to, "-12-31"))
    ) %>%
    inner_join(df_route_spot_long, by = c("路線" = "路線", "下車站牌名稱" = "站名")) %>%
    mutate(平假日 = if_else(wday(日期) %in% c(1,7), "假日", "平日")) %>% 
    group_by(景點, 平假日) %>%
    summarise(人次 = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  df_total <- data %>%
    group_by(平假日) %>%
    summarise(人次 = sum(人次), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(景點 = "總計") %>%
    select(景點, 平假日, 人次)
  
  dates = seq.Date(from = as.Date(paste0(year.from, "-01-01")), to = as.Date(paste0(year.to, "-12-31")), by = "day")
  df_weekdays <- tibble(日期 = dates) %>% 
    mutate(
      平假日 = if_else(wday(日期) %in% c(1, 7), "假日", "平日")
    ) %>%
    count(平假日, name = "天數") %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = 平假日, values_from = 天數) %>% 
    data.frame()
  
  df_data <- bind_rows(data, df_total) %>%
    mutate(.is_total = (景點 == "總計")) %>%
    arrange(.is_total, 景點, factor(平假日, levels = c("平日", "假日"))) %>%
    select(-.is_total) %>% 
    pivot_wider(., names_from = 平假日, values_from = 人次) %>%
    mutate(平日平均 = 平日 / df_weekdays$平日,
           假日平均 = 假日 / df_weekdays$假日,
           平假日平均比值百分比 = (平日平均 / 假日平均 * 100) %>% round(., 2) %>% paste0(., "%")
           )

  # 寫入 .xlsx
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, paste0(year.from - 1911, "-", year.to - 1911, "年臺東縣平假日分析"))
  writeData(wb, sheet = paste0(year.from - 1911, "-", year.to - 1911, "年臺東縣平假日分析"), x = df_data)
  xlsx_path = paste0("datasets/", year.from - 1911, "-", year.to - 1911)
  if (!dir.exists(xlsx_path)) {
    dir.create(xlsx_path, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  saveWorkbook(wb, file = paste0(xlsx_path, "/", year.from - 1911, "-", year.to - 1911, "年臺東縣平假日分析.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
}

weekday_analysis(2023, 2025)
```

# 上下車鄉鎮分析 
## 讀取 TDX 資料
```{r}
TDX_path = "../data/公路客運_花蓮市區公車_台東市區公車站點鄉鎮.csv"
df_TDX = read_csv(TDX_path, locale = locale(encoding = "BIG5"))
df_TDX.summary <- df_TDX %>% df_summary(.)

df_TDX_reduce <- df_TDX %>% 
  mutate(RouteName = as.character(RouteName)) %>% 
  select(RouteName, SubRouteName, Direction, StopName, PositionLon, PositionLat, COUNTYNAME, TOWNNAME) %>%
  filter(SubRouteName %in% routes) %>%
  select(-PositionLon, -PositionLat) %>% 
  distinct()
df_TDX_reduce.summary <- df_TDX_reduce %>% df_summary(.)
```

## 重複資料檢查
```{r}
# 先統計兩邊 key 出現次數
left_count <- df %>%
    count(子路線, 方向, 上車站牌名稱, name = "n_left")

right_count <- df_TDX_reduce %>%
    count(SubRouteName, Direction, StopName, name = "n_right")

# 合併統計，檢查多對多
conflicts <- left_count %>%
    inner_join(right_count, 
               by = c("子路線" = "SubRouteName", "方向" = "Direction", "上車站牌名稱" = "StopName")) %>%
    mutate(expanded_rows = n_left * n_right) %>%
    filter(n_left > 1 & n_right > 1)   # 只挑出真正 many-to-many 的

conflicts
```

## 小港資料修改
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    上車站牌名稱 = case_when(
      上車站牌名稱 == "小港" & 方向 == 0 & 上車站序 < 70 ~ "小港(花蓮)",
      上車站牌名稱 == "小港" & 方向 == 0 & 上車站序 >= 70 ~ "小港(台東)",
      上車站牌名稱 == "小港" & 方向 == 1 & 上車站序 < 10 ~ "小港(台東)",
      上車站牌名稱 == "小港" & 方向 == 1 & 上車站序 >= 10 ~ "小港(花蓮)",
      TRUE ~ 上車站牌名稱
    ),
    下車站牌名稱 = case_when(
      下車站牌名稱 == "小港" & 方向 == 0 & 下車站序 < 70 ~ "小港(花蓮)",
      下車站牌名稱 == "小港" & 方向 == 0 & 下車站序 >= 70 ~ "小港(台東)",
      下車站牌名稱 == "小港" & 方向 == 1 & 下車站序 < 10 ~ "小港(台東)",
      下車站牌名稱 == "小港" & 方向 == 1 & 下車站序 >= 10 ~ "小港(花蓮)",
      TRUE ~ 下車站牌名稱
    )
  )

df_TDX_reduce <- df_TDX_reduce %>%
  mutate(
    StopName = case_when(
      StopName == "小港" & COUNTYNAME == "臺東縣" ~ "小港(台東)",
      StopName == "小港" & COUNTYNAME == "花蓮縣" ~ "小港(花蓮)",
      TRUE ~ StopName
    )
  )
```

```{r}
right_count <- df_TDX_reduce %>%
    count(SubRouteName, Direction, StopName, name = "n_right")

# 合併統計，檢查多對多
conflicts <- left_count %>%
    inner_join(right_count, 
               by = c("子路線" = "SubRouteName", "方向" = "Direction", "上車站牌名稱" = "StopName")) %>%
    mutate(expanded_rows = n_left * n_right) %>%
    filter(n_left > 1 & n_right > 1)   # 只挑出真正 many-to-many 的

conflicts
```

## 熱力圖分析
```{r}
year.from = 2025
year.to = 2025

data <- df %>% 
  select(路線, 子路線, 日期, 方向, 上車站牌名稱, 下車站牌名稱, 業者編號) %>% 
  filter(
      日期 >= as.Date(paste0(year.from, "-01-01")),
      日期 <= as.Date(paste0(year.to, "-12-31")),
      !(上車站牌名稱 %in% c("", "-99") | is.na(上車站牌名稱)),
      !(下車站牌名稱 %in% c("", "-99") | is.na(下車站牌名稱))
    ) %>% 
  
  # 上車鄉鎮
  ## 依去返程分類
  left_join(df_TDX_reduce, by = c("子路線" = "SubRouteName", 
                                  "方向" = "Direction", 
                                  "上車站牌名稱" = "StopName")
            ) %>% 
  select(-RouteName) %>% 
  rename(上車縣市 = COUNTYNAME, 上車鄉鎮 = TOWNNAME) %>% 
  ## 依照無法判別去返程 (255) 再次分類
  left_join(df_TDX_reduce %>% 
              select(-Direction, -SubRouteName) %>% 
              distinct(RouteName, StopName, .keep_all = TRUE),  # 只保留第一筆匹配到的鄉鎮，移除重複站名
            by = c("路線" = "RouteName", 
                   "上車站牌名稱" = "StopName")
            ) %>% 
  mutate(
    上車鄉鎮 = if_else(is.na(上車鄉鎮), TOWNNAME, 上車鄉鎮),
    上車縣市 = if_else(is.na(上車縣市), COUNTYNAME, 上車縣市)
  ) %>%
  select(-TOWNNAME, -COUNTYNAME) %>% 
  
  # 下車鄉鎮
  ## 依去返程分類
  left_join(df_TDX_reduce, by = c("子路線" = "SubRouteName", 
                                  "方向" = "Direction", 
                                  "下車站牌名稱" = "StopName")
            ) %>% 
  select(-RouteName) %>% 
  rename(下車縣市 = COUNTYNAME, 下車鄉鎮 = TOWNNAME) %>% 
  ## 依照無法判別 (255) 再次分類
    left_join(df_TDX_reduce %>% 
              select(-Direction, -SubRouteName) %>% 
              distinct(RouteName, StopName, .keep_all = TRUE),  # 只保留第一筆匹配到的鄉鎮，移除重複站名
            by = c("路線" = "RouteName", 
                   "下車站牌名稱" = "StopName")
            ) %>% 
  mutate(
    下車鄉鎮 = if_else(is.na(下車鄉鎮), TOWNNAME, 下車鄉鎮),
    下車縣市 = if_else(is.na(下車縣市), COUNTYNAME, 下車縣市)
  ) %>%
  select(-TOWNNAME, -COUNTYNAME) %>%
  filter(上車縣市 == "臺東縣" | 下車縣市 == "臺東縣")
```

## 檢查上下車站點所在鄉鎮是否存在 NA 情況，如有則需修改對照表
```{r}
# 上車鄉鎮為 NA 的站點
up_na <- data %>%
  filter(is.na(上車鄉鎮)) %>%
  select(子路線, 上車站牌名稱) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rename(站點名稱 = 上車站牌名稱)

# 下車鄉鎮為 NA 的站點
down_na <- data %>%
  filter(is.na(下車鄉鎮)) %>%
  select(子路線, 下車站牌名稱) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rename(站點名稱 = 下車站牌名稱)

df_township_analysis_na_stop <- bind_rows(up_na, down_na) %>% 
  distinct()

print(df_township_analysis_na_stop)
```

```{r}
data <- data %>% 
  # 修改外縣鄉鎮 -> 外縣
  mutate(
    上車鄉鎮 = if_else(上車縣市 != "臺東縣", 上車縣市, 上車鄉鎮),
    下車鄉鎮 = if_else(下車縣市 != "臺東縣", 下車縣市, 下車鄉鎮)
  ) %>%
  select(上車鄉鎮, 下車鄉鎮) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  # 排序南到北
  mutate(
    上車鄉鎮 = factor(上車鄉鎮, levels = ttt_township_order),
    下車鄉鎮 = factor(下車鄉鎮, levels = ttt_township_order)
  ) %>% 
  # 計算鄉鎮數量
  group_by(上車鄉鎮, 下車鄉鎮) %>% 
  summarise(數量 = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(數量))

# 寫入 .xlsx
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, paste0(year.from - 1911, "年臺東縣鄉鎮上下車"))
writeData(wb, sheet = paste0(year.from - 1911, "年臺東縣鄉鎮上下車"), x = data %>% pivot_wider(names_from = 下車鄉鎮, values_from = 數量))
xlsx_path = paste0("datasets/", year.from - 1911)
if (!dir.exists(xlsx_path)) {
  dir.create(xlsx_path, recursive = TRUE)
}
saveWorkbook(wb, file = paste0(xlsx_path, "/", paste0(year.from - 1911, "年臺東縣鄉鎮上下車.xlsx")), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## 鄉鎮上下車熱力圖
```{r}
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = 下車鄉鎮, y = 上車鄉鎮)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = 數量), color = "white") + 
  scale_fill_gradient(
    trans = "sqrt",                      # ✅ 填色開根號變換
    # low = "white", high = "red",
    low = "grey90",          # 幾乎白
    high = "grey10",         # 幾乎黑
    labels = scales::comma                  # ✅ 格式化數字
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("臺東縣", year.from - 1911, "年客運鄉鎮搭乘需求熱力圖"),
    x = "下車鄉鎮",
    y = "上車鄉鎮",
    fill = "乘客數量"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Kai") +   
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45,
                                hjust = 1,
                                family = "Kai",
                                size = 12), # X軸字體大小
    axis.text.y  = element_text(family = "Kai",
                                size = 12), # Y軸字體大小
    axis.title.x = element_text(family = "Kai",
                                size = 14), # X軸標題大小
    axis.title.y = element_text(family = "Kai",
                                size = 14), # Y軸標題大小
    plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0,
                                family = "Kai",
                                size = 18,
                                face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(family = "Kai", size = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(family = "Kai", size = 12)
  )
```
